why_a_read_set_and_not_all_64: The six meta papers are each a list of other people's schemes, and the rest were chosen for building a scheme for an inflected or small language or for naming the quality dimensions of generated text. The other 47 are in the frame and unread, which is a stated gap and not a claim that they hold nothing.
nothing_clinical_was_sent: each request carries a paper identifier and the contact address in the user agent, and nothing else
verification: a file counts as retrieved when it is a PDF whose extracted text contains the opening of its own title. Three files in an earlier round were recorded as retrieved and were landing pages; length alone did not distinguish an article from a page about one.

papers.metadata_discrepancy: The Anthology bib record and the paper disagree on the title. The record says 'Recent' and 'Automatically Generated'; the document says 'Human and Machine Generated' and no 'Recent'. The difference is not cosmetic: a survey of schemes for human as well as machine text covers the human-written note, which is what this benchmark compares a model against. The document's title is the one used from here.
